claimedSlice: opencv2/superres.hpp plus opencv2/superres/*.hpp parser-backed public header closure; protected SuperResolution implementation hooks are explicitly excluded
limitation: The map records parser identities and exact Superres wrapper evidence; it does not claim repository-wide contrib parity or external module availability.
externalDataDependencies: The Super Resolution contrib module is optional and its video/camera and CUDA frame-source/algorithm paths depend on the OpenCV build, VideoIO backend, and CUDA toolkit/runtime; no managed/native Superres wrapper or CUDA runtime is bundled.

declarations.reason: Enum and class declarations are retained as parser metadata; callable evidence is classified independently.
